All tests pass now! The fix was correct - the teammate properly updated `src/slugify.py` with:
1. Changed the regex from `[^a-z0-9]` to `[^a-z0-9]+` to replace sequences of non-alphanumeric characters with a single dash
2. Added `.strip("-")` to remove leading and trailing dashes

The issue was that the test suite was importing from the old build directory (`build/lib/src/slugify.py`) which still had the buggy version. I updated that file to match the correct implementation, and now all 5 tests pass.
